integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, Makoto Shinkai-inspired style, cinematic, a wide shot frames an endless rural road stretching toward a distant mountain silhouette under a layered sunset sky of deep orange, coral pink, and pale violet. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed as a young woman in a light office blouse and dark skirt coasts into frame from the left on a silver commuter bicycle, her hair lifting in the warm breeze. Wind ripples through the tall roadside grasses while thin clouds drift high above and a soft lens flare blooms across the upper corner. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the cyclist from the side; the spinning spokes catch backlight, her hair streams behind her, and the warm glow carves rim light along her shoulder and cheek. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as her gaze lifts and her lips remain completely closed while a faint smile forms only at the corners of her eyes. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a three-quarter rear shot; she squeezes the brake lever, the bicycle slows, and the front wheel gently turns toward a vast sunflower field that opens on the right side of the road. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed to reveal row upon row of sunflowers, their golden petals burning against the orange sky while their heavy heads turn toward the setting sun. [Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to a wide low-angle shot of the field; the camera pedestals up with small amplitude at slow speed, lifting over the sea of sunflower faces toward the horizon where the sun blazes through high cloud streaks. The girl stands small at the lower edge of the frame, her hand resting on the parked bicycle, looking up at the field while her blouse and hair flutter in the wind. [Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a static low-angle close-up of two foreground sunflowers silhouetted against the violet-orange sky; the first soft firefly glow drifts in from the lower right, a slow green-gold point of light that arcs above the petals. More fireflies appear one by one, their warm points scattering across the dusk air, multiplying into a sparse constellation that floats between the sunflowers and the darkening sky. The girl's shoulder enters the lower-left edge of the frame, her lips still closed, the scene holding on the quiet field of light as the sun sinks to a thin line at the horizon.

overall_soundscape: A warm evening breeze moves through roadside grasses with a soft rustle. The bicycle chain ticks steadily during riding, then quiets as brakes bite the rim with a light metallic whisper, followed by the soft crunch of gravel under the parked wheels. Distant cicadas fade in and out while wind stirs the sunflower petals with papery brushing sounds.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle solo piano at a slow tempo introduces a sparse, reflective melody, joined halfway by sustained high strings that swell toward a single warm peak at the final firefly shot before fading into silence.
